en.headline: Science Park and Roche upgrade partnership to end-to-end support for medtech startups
en.dek: The Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation and Roche signed a strategic agreement to expand collaboration on AI-enabled early screening and clinical translation for local innovators.
body: The Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation and pharmaceutical company Roche announced a strategic collaboration agreement that upgrades their existing partnership to provide end-to-end support for medical technology startups.

The agreement, signed on Thursday, builds on cooperation that began in 2023. It focuses on introducing artificial-intelligence tools for earlier detection of cancer and chronic diseases, accelerating clinical validation of local innovations, and linking Science Park’s Incu-Bio programme with Roche’s global network to help startups reach international markets.

Executives said the work aligns with Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the shift toward preventive primary healthcare. Roche has already supported several Science Park startups in areas including AI-driven drug development, nucleic-acid medicines and novel diagnostics.

Roche Diagnostics Hong Kong general manager Ronald Lo noted that early diagnosis of conditions such as heart failure can yield substantial system-wide savings, citing research that each dollar spent on early detection can return twelve dollars in reduced treatment costs.

zh.headline: 科技園與羅氏簽署戰略協議 升級端到端支援醫療科技初創
zh.dek: 香港科技園公司與羅氏周四簽署協議，將2023年起的合作提升至端到端轉化及商業化支援，聚焦AI輔助癌症與慢性病早篩及本地初創臨床轉化。
body: 香港科技園公司與跨國藥企羅氏宣布簽署戰略合作協議，把雙方自2023年展開的合作升級為端到端支援，協助醫療科技初創企業由研發走向商業化。
協議聚焦引入人工智能技術，推動癌症及慢性病早期篩檢，加速本地創新的臨床驗證，並結合科技園Incu-Bio計劃與羅氏全球網絡，協助初創開拓國際市場。
雙方表示，合作方向配合本港首個五年規劃及基層醫療「預防為重」的政策。過去兩年，羅氏已支援園區多家初創，涵蓋AI製藥、核酸藥物及新型診斷等領域。
羅氏診斷香港總經理羅子賢引述研究指，以心衰竭為例，及早診斷每投入1元，可為整個醫療體系帶來約12元回報，有助減輕公營醫療負擔。
